contract_line: P1 casts first spell of turn -> trigger exiles P1 top card; if nonland, P0 (controller) must be offered the may-cast. Leg 1: P0 accepts -> free cast under P0 control, 3 damage to P1, Bolt to P1 gy. Leg 2: P0 declines -> card stays exiled.
driver_notes: Protocol-70 OptionalEffectChoice opportunity shape: response.type=exactChoices with choices at response.data.choices (not response.choices); surfaces nest as {type, data:{code,action,role,value}}; value surface carries role=accept with value=true(accept)/false(decline) -- c0=false=decline, c1=true=accept, so a first=accept fallback would be wrong.

P0's may-cast accept is submitted as {type:choose,data:{choiceId:<id>}}; the engine then routes the free cast through TargetSelection (P0-controlled spell on stack) rather than a direct cast offer -- the driver's inline A4 evaluator only flagged freecast_submitted on the direct-offer path, so A4 was corrected post-run from saved states + wire evidence (cf. #4345/#4509). Scenario patched to set freecast_submitted on the target-selection path for future runs.
P1's trigger Bolt targeted P0 via sequence answer on TargetSelection (seat-0 candidate).
Earlier attempts 20260912-6901[a-f] (same issue) died before completing; attempt f reached the may-cast decision but held it unhandled due to the surface-shape mismatch fixed in this run.
limitations: Browser UI not exercised; native engine via two human-client seats.
12x Mind's Dilation / 44x Lightning Bolt deck density is a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games).
Not tested on the original 2026-08-02 build; verdict is not-reproduced on v0.81.2, not a fix claim.
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay).
result: A1 setup_ok: passed (Dilation on P0 BF turn 14; P1 Bolt cast as first spell turn 15). A2 exile_observed: passed (P1 top card exiled: Lightning Bolt oid66 owner 1, P1 lib 46->45). A3 maycast_offered_to_controller: passed (OptionalEffectChoice offered to seat 0, wf_player=0; answered accept). A4 accept_casts_free: passed (corrected post-run: accept submission accepted; engine presented TargetSelection for the P0-controlled free-cast Bolt; P0 targeted P1; resolved P1 20->17; exiled Bolt oid66 Exile->P1 graveyard; no mana paid by P0 -- no PayMana interaction offered, 0 untapped Islands at accept). A5 decline_leaves_exiled: passed (leg-2 exiled Bolt oid71 still in exile; P1 17->17; no free-cast damage). A6 cleanup: passed (stack empty, game advanced to turn 17 EndCombat).
scope: Full reported contract: Mind's Dilation trigger on opponent's first spell each turn; the may-cast permission must be offered to the Dilation controller; accept casts the exiled nonland card for free under the controller's control; decline leaves it exiled. Native engine, two human-client seats, protocol 70.
title: Mind's Dilation — Doesn't seem to give the ability to cast the exiled card to the owner of Mind's Dilation
